evaluations.query: I'm on the next branch and need to start implementing a fix for duplicate event handling. Set up the git branch correctly before I edit files.
expected_behavior: Checks current branch with git branch --show-current
Refuses to commit or edit while planning to stay on next
Creates a feature branch using type/description-$(date +%s), e.g. fix/duplicate-event-handling-<timestamp>

evaluations.query: Pre-commit hooks failed after my commit because Biome formatting changed files. Finish the commit.
expected_behavior: Runs formatting/fixes (e.g. pnpm format) and stages the fixes
Retries the commit without bypassing hooks
Requests user approval before committing or pushing if not already granted

evaluations.query: Write a commit message and open a PR for adding JWT auth to apps/web. Include what the PR body should contain.
expected_behavior: Uses conventional commit form type(scope): summary, e.g. feat(apps/web): ...
PR guidance includes summary, test commands, and screenshots note for UI changes
Targets next as the base branch
Does not commit directly to next
Requests user approval before committing or pushing

evaluations.query: I'm done with my feature branch and want to switch back to next to start something else.
